alignment.verdict: Numeric consistency with advertised official ordering, NOT cryptographic row-ID provenance

reproducibility.verdict: Shared vectors reproducible as arithmetic inputs; producing the original models is NOT independently reproduced

licenses.tabpfn35: Previously pinned non-commercial model license explicitly includes data science competitions; champion source manifest preserved
licenses.kumo: Official NVIDIA model card declares OpenMDW-1.1; permissive use, full producer still absent
licenses.limix2: Current LICENSE is custom Non-Commercial v1.0, despite model-card prose saying Apache2. Section5 explicitly includes non-commercial Kaggle; commercial and competing-foundation-model restrictions remain. Blanket LICENSE_BLOCKED from old catalogue is incomplete; no weights adopted.
licenses.causilo: Custom v1.0 permits noncommercial evaluation; outputs are excluded from Derivative definition but commercial/production restrictions remain. No distillation or submitted incorporation.
licenses.exaone: Model weights NC1.2, separate from MIT code; model-output restrictions require review for intended downstream use. Diagnostic only.
licenses.scope: Source audit, not blanket legal certification of all11 producers or a finding that every NC model is banned.
licenses.tabfm: Google source code Apache-2.0, pretrained weights separate tabfm-non-commercial-v1.0, noncommercial/nonproduction only. Exact producer checkpoint revision unprovided.
licenses.mitra2: Official autogluon/mitra-classifier-2 model card declares Apache-2.0. Exact shared-vector producer revision and modified implementation unprovided.
licenses.tabicl2: Official jingang/TabICL model card for TabICLv2 declares BSD-3-Clause. Exact shared-vector producer revision unprovided.
licenses.realmlp: PyTabKit source license must be distinguished from the shared trained predictions; upstream producer configuration and exact revision unprovided. Dataset vectors CC0; no new weights adopted.
licenses.xgboost: Official dmlc/xgboost Apache-2.0 source. Exact tuned producer configuration and training contexts unprovided.

candidate_decision: The two raw TabPFN35 mixtures numerically pass discovery. Both remain ineligible: unverified context and row manifests, mismatched primary scheme, absent matched shadow, no clean-code producer reproduction.
next_needed_for_raw8: An own raw21 TabPFN3.5 eight-estimator five-primary run, frozen weight, matched shadow and full-test inference. GPU hard stop and unbounded remaining budget prevent execution. Raw1 replay is not equivalent to raw8.
